citation.text_span: Tranche reference SN-2026-0103
The Notes are issued by Northbridge Capital Markets (Canada) Inc..
The aggregate Notional Amount is 8,000,000 CAD.
The Specified Currency is CAD and all payments under the Notes are made in CAD.
Trade Date: March 3, 2026.
Issue Date: March 10, 2026.
Maturity Date: March 12, 2029, subject to adjustment in accordance with Condition 9.
linked to the worst performing of the S&P/TSX 60 Index (Bloomberg: SPTSX60 Index) and the BVERSA10 Index (Bloomberg: BVERSA10 Index)
The Initial Level is 100 per cent. of the official closing level of each Underlying on the Trade Date.
the Notes are subject to a knock-in barrier observed on the Final Valuation Date only (European observation)
at a Knock-in Level of 70 per cent. of the Initial Level
the Notes bear a Coupon of 6.8 per cent. per annum, payable quarterly
a Coupon of 6.8 per cent. per annum
Coupons are payable quarterly in arrear
Memory feature: if a Coupon is not paid on a Coupon Payment Date because the Coupon Condition is not satisfied, that Coupon is not lost.
Autocall Observation Dates: March 3, 2027, September 3, 2027, March 3, 2028, September 5, 2028.
if on any Autocall Observation Date the closing level of the Underlying is at or above 100 per cent. of the Initial Level
calculated on the basis of Actual/360
Cash settlement.
it shall be adjusted in accordance with the Modified Following Business Day Convention
